AI video's biggest problem is control. You rarely get quite what you asked for.

This technique fixes it.

Draft in 3JS, generate style with image gen, and fuse with video gen.

How to do it: https://t.co/FKMgLjPND3 https://t.co/CG11SmgVTJ

Such an interesting and simple approach to controlled video generation:

- use code to create the “skeleton” of the video, baking in all actions, objects, etc. at low fidelity
- pass the resulting “draft” through a video model to “make it real”
